name: phd-bloco-de-notas
description: PHD Bloco de Notas - aplicativo multiusuario com funcionamento web e Android.

scripts.copy:web: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const files=['index.html','styles.css','app.js','config.js','manifest.webmanifest','service-worker.js','icon-192.png','icon-512.png','apple-touch-icon.png'];fs.rmSync('www',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true});for(const f of files){if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Arquivo ausente: '+f);fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f)}console.log('www preparado com '+files.length+' arquivos');"
scripts.build:web: npm run bundle && npm run copy:web
scripts.android:add: npm run build:web && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
